feature_space_semantics.raw_consumption: All three detectors evaluate the identical 1D raw consumption feature [energy_consumption] over identical eligible timestamps.
feature_space_semantics.seasonal_deviation: All three detectors share the identical 24-hour causal lookback eligibility mask, but statistical_zscore is intentionally a univariate reference baseline scoring 1D |slot_zscore|, whereas isolation_forest and lof_novelty evaluate the 3D vector [slot_zscore, lag_1h_scaled_diff, lag_24h_scaled_diff]. Comparisons in seasonal_deviation therefore compare a univariate marginal seasonal baseline against multivariate seasonal-plus-ramp detectors on the same eligible hours, not identical feature dimensionality.
